title: The Noise Ceiling
description: Watch an FHE ciphertext's noise climb toward the decryption ceiling as you evaluate a circuit — and see why CKKS bootstraps rarely-but-slowly while TFHE bootstraps constantly-but-cheaply.
controls: drag circuit-depth slider to add multiplications
drag noise-budget slider to set leveled headroom
tap Evaluate to animate the noise sawtooth
tap a model card to pin its measured FHE-vs-MPC latency

dataSource.label: Beyond Latency: System-Level Characterization of MPC & FHE for PPML (arXiv 2604.00169) + SoK: Can FHE Support General AI Computation? (arXiv 2504.11604)
